notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Zombies.
description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {4}{R}.
Poppet Stitcher triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
The Zombie enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Searing Touch to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {R}.
Repeat.
